verdict.rationale: Docusign is an e-signature/agreement platform, not a legal document generation or incorporation-workflow tool; it does not produce or manage the substantive legal content of founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment agreements, or 83(b) elections — it can only be used to sign documents someone else prepared. Post-incorporation legal paperwork generation is outside its product category (wrong axis), so this is a category error rather than a missing feature.
